title: China CPI & PPI Data — Global Liquidity Scan
desc: A critical look at the world’s manufacturing hub. Deflationary PPI signals in China often precede global price cooling, which would provide a structural 'macro tailwind' for BTC and Gold as the market anticipates central bank easing.

title: US Senate Vote on Fed Leadership
desc: The official vote on Walsh's appointment. Fed leadership transitions are key volatility triggers; any hawkish commentary during the confirmation could tighten financial conditions and pressure risk assets before Tuesday's CPI.

title: US Consumer Price Index (CPI) Report
desc: The 'Volatility King' of the week. If April's inflation data comes in cooler than expected (<3.5%), it confirms the 'Soft Landing' and could trigger a breakout above the $82k resistance. A hot print kills the rate-cut hope and tests the $78k floor.

title: Avalanche (AVAX) & Aptos (APT) Unlock Cluster
desc: A dual-supply event for high-throughput L1s. While these are routine unlocks, their alignment with CPI day increases the risk of 'Stop-Loss Hunting.' Watch for volatility in the AVAX/BTC and APT/BTC pairs as supply hits the market.

title: US Producer Price Index (PPI)
desc: The 'Inflation Pipeline' update. High producer prices usually bleed into consumer prices. A hot PPI following a hot CPI would be a 'Double-Hawkish' signal, likely pushing the BitLogic Divergence Score into deep negative territory.

title: US Retail Sales — Consumer Resilience Check
desc: Data on whether the US consumer is still driving the economy. Strong retail sales bolster the 'Higher for Longer' Fed stance, strengthening the DXY and potentially capping crypto gains for the week.

title: Arbitrum (ARB) & STBL Major Unlock
desc: A significant supply dilution for the L2 sector. ~$28M total across both assets entering circulation. In the current 'Disbelief Phase,' these events test if the market liquidity floor is thick enough to absorb sell pressure without price breakdown.

title: BitLogic Alpha Weekly Macro Review
desc: Closing the week by synthesizing the CPI/PPI data into our Net Liquidity Model. We determine if the $5.85T floor moved and set the 'High-Conviction' zones for the upcoming week's trade setup.
